AL-3001.title: Suspicious PowerShell on WS-114
AL-3001.summary: EDR flagged an encoded PowerShell command spawned by winword.exe on host WS-114 at 02:14 UTC. Parent process chain is consistent with a macro-enabled attachment. User session E-100.
AL-3001.enrichment: Threat intel feed: hash matches a commodity loader family observed in phishing campaigns since June. Confidence medium.

AL-3002.title: Impossible travel for E-221
AL-3002.summary: Sign-in from Tunis at 09:02 and from Frankfurt at 09:41 for user E-221.
AL-3002.enrichment: Threat intel feed: both ASNs are consumer ISPs. No known malicious infrastructure.
